text:
Nina CSM: FYI Marigold Health renewal hits next Tue. They want to shorten to a 10-month term (start Apr 15) and add 5 extra seats. Procurement hasn't provided vendor code or W-9. Also eSign bounced — signer used an alias. Need quick triage.
Omar AM: Do they want billing to start Apr 15 or align with their fiscal month?
Nina CSM: They asked for Apr 15 start and pro-rated invoice. Seat add is immediate.
Ryan Finance: We can do proration but need vendor code + W-9 to issue invoice. If PO missing at renewal we need an amendment and credit note. Also clarify Net terms (customer prefers Net30).
Leah Legal: Who is on the signature block? If alias, we need either the corporate email or a signed delegated-authority letter.
Nina CSM: Signer listed as "Sam M." (sam@marigold.io) but envelope failed: "recipient requires identity verification".
docusign-bot: ERROR: Recipient identity check failed. Options: resend with ID check or collect delegation doc.
procurement-bot: Reminder: W-9 required for US entities before invoicing.
Omar AM: I have Sam's direct mobile. I'll confirm preferred email and ask procurement for vendor code + W-9.
Taylor Enablement: Heads up — training resources scheduled week after renewal. If contract not fully executed we'll need to move trainers.
Ryan Finance: Quick action: if PO/PDF arrives before renewal we'll proceed with proration math. If not, we'll issue short amendment with retro credit. Please include exact seat count for proration calc.
Nina CSM: Action list: Omar to get vendor code + W-9 + confirm signer email (ETA today). Leah to prepare a one-paragraph delegated-authority template. Ryan to draft proration stub. Taylor to tentatively hold training slots.
Omar AM: Update — procurement replied: vendor code MG-2201. W-9 attached in DM. Sam prefers sam.mitchell@marigold.io as signer. Uploading W-9 to ticket now.
Nina CSM: Uploaded W-9 and vendor code to Zendesk. Resending envelope to sam.mitchell@marigold.io.
docusign-bot: SENT: Envelope 9f3a7d to sam.mitchell@marigold.io (identity verification enabled).
Leah Legal: If ID check blocks signer, use delegated-authority template: "I, [Name], [Title], confirm authority to bind Marigold Health for PO #..." — will DM full text.
Ryan Finance: Once envelope complete, I'll calculate proration using: "Prorated = (annual fee / 12) * months active + (seat delta * seat price * months)". Will post numbers.
Taylor Enablement: Trainers on stand-by for now. If contract clears by EOD tomorrow we keep current schedule.
Omar AM: Envelope signed. Sam completed identity verification.
docusign-bot: COMPLETED: Envelope 9f3a7d signed by sam.mitchell@marigold.io at 2026-03-20T15:12:03Z.
Nina CSM: Great — Leah/Ryan please finalize amendment text and proration calc. I'll confirm training.
Leah Legal: Draft amendment ready; sending via DM. Includes 10-month term, effective Apr 15, seat add details, Net30, and W-9 / vendor code acknowledgement.
Ryan Finance: Proration posted to ticket: annual fee $120k -> monthly $10k. Months charged = 10 => $100k + 5 seats @ $2k/mo prorated for 10 months = $10k -> total $110k. Invoice terms Net30.
Taylor Enablement: Confirmed trainers will run onboarding Apr 22. Marking as confirmed.
Nina CSM: Closing loop — contract executed, W-9 & vendor code in ticket, invoice to issue net30. Thanks everyone :tada:
